observedSignals: Target node unmounted during asynchronous verification phase
Identical HTML node mounted in parent container by React virtual DOM reconciler
Transaction state transitioning from SNAPSHOTTED to APPLYING
expectedInterpretation: Stale transaction target; unmounted node must not be mutated or rolled back on replacement node
actualInterpretation: ABORTED_STALE triggered via deterministic node identity check
rootCause: SPA frameworks replace real DOM nodes during re-render cycles, causing naive element references to mutate unmanaged replacement nodes.
calibrationRule: Enforce computeDeterministicNodeIdentity and isConnected check before apply/verify/rollback; set state to ABORTED_STALE on mismatch.
